name: Google Drive
description: Google Drive plugin for Mattermost - Create, share files in Google Drive and receive notifications for shared files and comments on files

settings_schema.header: Configure the Google Drive plugin to allow users to connect their Google accounts and interact with Google Drive files.

settings.help_text: The Client ID from your Google Cloud Console OAuth 2.0 credentials.
settings.placeholder: Enter your Google OAuth Client ID

settings.help_text: The Client Secret from your Google Cloud Console OAuth 2.0 credentials.
settings.placeholder: Enter your Google OAuth Client Secret

settings.help_text: The AES encryption key used to encrypt stored access tokens. Regenerating this key will invalidate all existing Google account connections.
settings.regenerate_help_text: Regenerating this key will invalidate all existing Google account connections.

settings.help_text: The JSON credentials for your Google Cloud Service Account. This is used for webhook notifications.
settings.placeholder: Paste your service account JSON credentials here
